$description: QRCode (platform/components/QRCode, library wave 4, lane B): its component tokens.

qr-code-plate-color.$description: QRCode: the light plate under the modules, the quiet zone included (white in both modes: the media roles do not follow the theme).

qr-code-module-color.$description: QRCode: the dark modules, and a logo in the center (black in both modes: the media roles do not follow the theme).

qr-code-plate-radius.$description: QRCode: the plate’s corners (inside the quiet zone, so they never touch a module).

qr-code-sm-size.$description: QRCode size sm: the code with its quiet zone (96px).

qr-code-md-size.$description: QRCode size md: the code with its quiet zone (160px, the default).

qr-code-lg-size.$description: QRCode size lg: the code with its quiet zone (240px).

qr-code-sm-logo-size.$description: QRCode size sm: the logo’s box, inside the cleared center.

qr-code-md-logo-size.$description: QRCode size md: the logo’s box, inside the cleared center.

qr-code-lg-logo-size.$description: QRCode size lg: the logo’s box, inside the cleared center.

qr-code-caption-gap.$description: QRCode: the gap between the code and its caption.

qr-code-value-gap.$description: QRCode: the gap between the caption and the value.

qr-code-caption-line-height.$description: QRCode: the line height of the caption and the value.

qr-code-value-color.$description: QRCode: the encoded value under the caption.

qr-code-value-font-family.$description: QRCode: the value’s face (the data font: a URL or a code).
